question: How must the two formations be oriented to constitute the mudrā called kālakarṇikā?
premises: The same two formations are used.
They must be made facing each other.
inference: Placing the two formations face to face produces the kālakarṇikā mudrā.
uncertainties: The referent of tāveva depends on the immediately preceding gesture.
plain_english: One should make those two facing each other; this mudrā is Kālakarṇikā.
